core: Colony-stimulating factor signaling in myeloid development
qualifier: macrophage and monocyte differentiation and bone marrow expansion
name: Colony-stimulating factor signaling in macrophage and monocyte development
rationale: Members centre on M-CSF/GM-CSF/G-CSF production and signaling driving macrophage, monocyte and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation and bone marrow cell proliferation/survival, unlike confusables focused on granulocyte/neutrophil transcriptional programs or osteoclasts.

qualifier: follicle and oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteal phase
name: Ovarian cycle: follicle and oocyte maturation, ovulation, luteolysis
rationale: All members concern the female ovarian/estrous cycle (antral follicle growth, oocyte meiotic maturation, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis, gonadotropin feedback), whereas confusables emphasize testis, gonadotropin hormone secretion and germ-cell biology.

name: Amino acid and nucleobase catabolism, chiefly histidine and threonine
rationale: Members are amino acid (histidine, threonine, tyrosine), amide and pyrimidine nucleobase catabolic processes, with histidine and threonine breakdown distinguishing them from phenylalanine/tyrosine and proline/glycine confusables.

name: Potassium channel families in cardiac action potential phases 1-4
rationale: Members are cardiac action potential phases 1-4 plus the voltage-gated, inward-rectifier and two-pore potassium channels that shape them, distinguishing them from nodal/atrial conduction and non-cardiac potassium-channel confusables.

name: Podocyte development and brush-border microvillus assembly
rationale: Members cover glomerular podocyte/epithelial development, nephrin interactions, glomerular basement membrane and albumin uptake together with microvillus/brush-border assembly, unlike confusables about glomerular endothelium/mesangium or general epithelial polarity.

name: Cytoskeletal organelle and vesicle transport, notably axonal and dendritic
rationale: Members describe microtubule/actin-based transport and positioning of mitochondria, endolysosomes, synaptic and dense-core vesicles, largely in axons and dendrites, distinct from confusables on kinesin/tubulin modification or lysosome-autophagy fusion.

core: Inorganic anion transport and its disorders
name: Inorganic anion transporter disorders and tooth mineralization
rationale: Members are bicarbonate, sulfate, iodide, oxalate and phosphate transporters and their genetic diseases plus enamel/dentin mineralization and ectopic calcification, unlike confusables on sodium-phosphate cotransport or proton/pH regulation.

name: CD28-family T cell costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: All members concern CD28 costimulatory signaling and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition tuning TCR signaling, distinguishing them from proximal TCR and BCR signaling confusables.

name: Positive regulation of JNK stress-activated kinase signaling
rationale: All three members are positive regulation of the JNK/stress-activated protein kinase cascade, unlike confusables about TLR/NOD-driven TAK1 and NF-kappaB activation.

qualifier: Hippo-YAP, RUNX3 and mutant TGF-beta receptor/SMAD
name: Hippo-YAP, RUNX3 and TGF-beta receptor tumor-suppressor signaling
rationale: Members combine Hippo/YAP-TAZ density sensing, RUNX3 target regulation and cancer mutants of TGF-beta receptors/SMADs, with Hippo and RUNX3 separating the theme from TGFBR3/activin-centred confusables.

name: Cell-cycle DNA replication initiation and replication-associated genome stability
rationale: Members cover replication initiation, unwinding, mitotic DNA replication, intra-S checkpoint and break-induced replication/DNA stability, narrower than the broad cell-cycle confusable and distinct from telomere and cohesion confusables.

qualifier: protein import and fatty acid oxidation
name: Peroxisomal protein import and fatty acid oxidation
rationale: Members are peroxisome biogenesis/protein import and peroxisomal alpha- and beta-oxidation of fatty acyl-CoAs, unlike confusables centred on very-long-chain fatty acid synthesis and ether lipid biosynthesis.

name: Spermine and spermidine interconversion and oxidative catabolism
rationale: All members concern spermine/spermidine metabolism and polyamine oxidase-mediated interconversion, distinct from putrescine synthesis/ODC and polyamine transport confusables.

name: Integrin-mediated leukocyte adhesion and extravasation across endothelium
rationale: Members describe integrin activation, leukocyte-endothelial adhesion, diapedesis and neutrophil/T cell extravasation, unlike confusables on endothelial shear stress/PECAM1 or monocyte activation.

name: Regulation of mitochondrial electron transport and ROS production
rationale: All members regulate mitochondrial respiratory chain activity, oxidative phosphorylation and ROS generation, distinct from confusables about oxidative-stress-induced cell death and hypoxia responses.

name: Axo-dendritic transport of synaptic vesicles and receptor cargo
rationale: Members are axonal/dendritic transport of dense-core and synaptic vesicles, neurotransmitter receptors and presynaptic proteins, unlike confusables on mitochondrial/organelle transport or the synaptic vesicle cycle.

qualifier: SR calcium uptake and sodium-calcium exchange
name: Cardiomyocyte calcium cycling via SR uptake and Na+/Ca2+ exchange
rationale: Members concern lowering cytosolic calcium by sarcoplasmic reticulum pumping and Na+/Ca2+ exchange, governing cardiac relaxation and force, unlike confusables about ryanodine-receptor calcium release and heart rate.

core: Cytidine deamination and immune receptor diversification
qualifier: antibody genes, B-cell development, antiviral restriction
name: Antibody gene diversification, B-cell development and antiviral cytidine deamination
rationale: Members combine AID/APOBEC cytidine deamination (somatic hypermutation, RNA editing, antiviral restriction) with immunoglobulin V(D)J recombination and early B cell development, unlike general DNA repair confusables.

name: Sema3A- and ephrin-mediated repulsive axon guidance and remodeling
rationale: Members are Sema3A-plexin and ephrin-Eph repulsion, growth cone collapse, fasciculation, nerve branching and pruning, distinct from netrin, Sema4D, L1/NCAM and collateral sprouting confusables.

core: Suppression of membrane ion flux and excitability
name: Inhibition of plasma-membrane calcium and potassium flux and excitability
rationale: Most members negatively regulate plasma-membrane calcium and potassium transport, action potentials and channel targeting to membrane (with one striated muscle apoptosis term), unlike sodium-transport, SR-calcium and cardiac action-potential confusables.

core: FGF receptor ligand binding and activation
name: Ligand binding and activation of FGFR1 and FGFR2 isoforms
rationale: All four members are ligand binding/activation of FGFR1b/c and FGFR2b/c, distinct from confusables covering FGFR3/4, downstream FRS/SHC/PLC cascades and activating mutants.

name: Megakaryocyte differentiation and platelet formation
rationale: Members concern megakaryocyte development and platelet morphogenesis (including restraint of erythroid fate), distinct from confusables on HSC, myeloid progenitor and erythroid differentiation.

qualifier: enzymatic degradation of dopamine and serotonin
name: Enzymatic degradation of dopamine, serotonin and other monoamines
rationale: All members describe oxidative deamination and methylation-based breakdown of biogenic amines, separating the theme from confusables on monoamine transport, reuptake and biosynthesis.

name: Pre-replicative complex assembly and licensing at replication origins
rationale: All members concern ORC/CDC6-dependent pre-replicative complex formation, activation and its restraint, narrower than confusables on broader replication initiation, checkpoints and E2F programs.

Members mix responses to ethanol, ether, anaesthetics, antibiotics and drugs with arginine-derived agmatine/nitric oxide/amine metabolism, hypoxia and oxidative-stress modulation and developmental apoptosis, sharing no single biological process.
